descricao_original: Surrounding the ductus deferens is a sheath of connective tissue housing the testicular artery, the pampiniform plexus of veins and small peripheral nerves. The venous plexus serves as a heat exchanger to reduce the temperature of the incoming blood in the testicular artery. 100x
